name: ICD API (WHO)
tagline: Official WHO ICD-11 API for diagnosis coding and classification.
description: The WHO ICD API provides programmatic access to the International Classification of Diseases, 11th Revision (ICD-11), including search, entity lookup, linearizations, and coding tools for health information systems.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 client credentials: register at icd.who.int/icdapi, then POST client_id/client_secret to the token endpoint for a Bearer access token.

use_cases: look up an ICD-11 entity by code or URI
search ICD-11 for a diagnosis term
get linearization details for a disease code
